nodes.label: CAC-by-cohort frame (India ~Rs 0 / global < $28)
nodes.rationale: Two different humans, never blend economics: India cohort is dataset/trust at near-zero CAC; global prosumer is the ARR engine with a $28 CAC ceiling (one month blended ARPU). Max 2 channels hot at once for 3 people.

nodes.label: SEO/content moat (programmatic 41 -> ~1,800 pages + GEO)
nodes.rationale: The 14 interactive chapters + 27 bot pages are the only runnable options-education corpus on the open web; template strategy x ticker in tranches of 200 to dodge scaled-content-abuse penalties. Compounds but slow — the moat, not the cold-start.

nodes.label: Founder-led short-form (the Phase-1 cold-start engine)
nodes.rationale: The clip is the demo: screen-recordings of the Bet Builder / bots disagreeing, 5 originals/week on one platform first; plan for a 2-3 month dead zone and never imply profit (FTC/SEBI).

nodes.label: 'Explain this trade' share card (CAC-reducer, not engine)
nodes.rationale: Auto-rendered share card with deep link reconstructing the exact trade; honest k-factor 0.15-0.35 so it assists channels 1/2/5 rather than driving growth alone.

nodes.label: Product Hunt + directory launch sequence (one-time moment)
nodes.rationale: The lasting prize is the backlink portfolio feeding domain authority, not the one-day spike; realistic top-5 yield ~1-3k signups, mostly tire-kickers.

nodes.label: Discord community (#1 retention/dataset/UGC moat)
nodes.rationale: Seed cold, staff at ~300+ members; gamify on mastery/streaks never P&L (P&L leaderboards invite SEBI scrutiny); home of the future UGC bot marketplace.

nodes.label: Two-tier referral (global double-sided months / India non-cash status)
nodes.rationale: Switch on only after a paid product exists; cash referral incentives on a money-adjacent product invite SEBI/FTC scrutiny in India, so India rewards are status-based only.

nodes.label: Broker + educator partnerships (Phase 2-3; #1 ARR-per-deal)
nodes.rationale: Model a realistic flat Rs 15-40 lakh/yr pilot, not Rs 7.2cr per-MAU fiction; the win is the logo and exit proof point. Never sponsor creators who post buy/sell calls.

nodes.label: Activation metric (% signups placing >=1 paper trade in 24h)
nodes.rationale: Every CAC number is wasted without activation instrumentation; gate channel scaling on it — the playbook's single biggest prior omission.
